responsibility: This file implements the AArch64 RTL pair-fusion pass that merges adjacent load or store instructions into `ldp`/`stp` forms when profitable and legal. It specializes the generic `pair_fusion` framework with AArch64-specific tests for register classes, operand modes, alias-check limits, writeback policies, and instruction recognition/generation, and exposes the `ldp_fusion` pass used both before and after reload under the `-mearly-ldp-fusion` and `-mlate-ldp-fusion` controls.
